verdict.rationale: Working Copy stores data as standard Git repositories and provides multiple mechanisms to get data out — Files app integration, document picker, drag-and-drop, a built-in WebDAV server, and full offline clones — all in the open Git format rather than a proprietary one. However, there's no explicit 'export everything and leave' feature or account/settings export, and no independent corroboration of a full data portability workflow. Missing for 10: a documented one-step full-account export, evidence of exporting app settings/identities alongside repo data, and independent confirmation of a clean migration-out workflow.
